finding_text: Specific identification tests are not conducted on components that have been accepted based on the supplier's report of analysis.

finding_text: The quality system to approve contract laboratories to perform microbiological testing of APIs, and excipients is deficient.

finding_text: Written procedures have not been developed for the of post marketing adverse drug experiences.

finding_text: In study JO for the Te a run was stopped due to instrument related errors and samples already injected were reinjected, but samples reinjection was not included in the study report.

finding_text: In study JO for theA, samples for subject (@) were reprocessed but not reported.

finding_text: In study Je for theOA the firm used calibration standards and QC samples outside the established stability time period of 35 days.

finding_text: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.
finding_text_ko: 공정 중 물질과 완제의약품 특성에 변동을 일으킬 수 있는 제조공정에 대해 그 결과물을 모니터링하고 공정 성능을 밸리데이션하는 관리 절차가 수립되어 있지 않다.

finding_text: Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding the system for monitoring environmental conditions.
finding_text_ko: 무균 공정 구역의 환경 조건 모니터링 시스템이 미흡하다.

finding_text: Changes in methods and procedures needed to correct and prevent identified quality problems are not implemented and effective.
finding_text_ko: 확인된 품질 문제를 시정·예방하는 데 필요한 방법 및 절차 변경이 시행되지 않았고 효과적이지도 않다.

finding_text: Testing and release ofdrug product for distribution do not include appropriate laboratory determination of satisfactory conformance to the identity and strength of each active ingredient prior to release.

finding_text: Procedures describing the handling of all written and oral complaints regarding a drug product are not established, written, and followed,, In December 2013, you stated that you were informed b ORGY that one or two patients had eye infections.

finding_text: Batch production and control records do not include complete information relating to the production and control of each batch.
finding_text_ko: 제조 및 관리 기록서(배치 기록)에 각 배치의 생산·관리에 관한 완전한 정보가 포함되어 있지 않다.

finding_text: Out-of-specification results are not thoroughly investigated in that assessments ofwhether significant problems exist, allocation ofthe tasks for corrective actions, and conclusions are not documented.
finding_text_ko: 기준일탈(OOS) 결과를 철저히 조사하지 않는다. 중대한 문제가 있는지에 대한 평가, 시정조치 업무 배정, 결론이 문서화되어 있지 않다.

finding_text: Waterused in the manufacture ofAPIs has not been demonstrated to be suitable for its intended use.

finding_text: Laboratory controls do not include the establishment ofscientifically sound and appropriate test procedures designed to assure that drug products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.
finding_text_ko: 시험실 관리에 의약품이 확인, 함량, 품질 및 순도에 관한 적절한 기준에 적합함을 보증하도록 설계된, 과학적으로 타당하고 적절한 시험 절차의 수립이 포함되어 있지 않다.
